description: This header file defines APIs and function prototypes for the Host Interface (HostIf) rbus Data Model Provider, including initialization and parameter get/set functions, as well as optional event subscription and data retrieval/set handlers when GTEST_ENABLE is defined.

methods.name: init_rbus_dml_provider
methods.description: Initializes the rbus Data Model Provider for HostIf.

methods.name: setRbusStringParam
methods.description: Sets a string parameter in rbus based on the parameter name and value.

methods.name: getRbusStringParam
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from rbus given the parameter name.

methods.name: TR_Dml_EventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles rbus event subscription actions (subscribe/unsubscribe) when GTEST_ENABLE is active.

methods.name: TR_Dml_GetHandler
methods.description: Handles rbus get requests for specific properties when GTEST_ENABLE is active.

methods.name: TR_Dml_SetHandler
methods.description: Handles rbus set requests for specific properties when GTEST_ENABLE is active.
